ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ABC=90^\circ$, BF is the median to the side AC, and DE is the median of $\triangle ABC$. If DE$=10$, then what is the length of BF?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since DE is the median of $\triangle ABC$, if DE=10,\\
then AC=2DE=20,\\
In the right triangle $\triangle ABC$, where $\angle ABC=90^\circ$, BF is the median to side AC,\\
thus BF=$\frac{1}{2}$AC=\boxed{10}.
